dataset_description.Name: EEGManyLabs - Resting State Dataset - HajcakHolroyd2005
dataset_description.Acknowledgements: We thank all contributing labs for collecting these data.

sex.Description: sex of the participant as reported by the participant

handedness.Description: handedness of the participant as determined by Edinburgh Handedness Inventory (EHI)

tod.Description: Time of day; local time of data collection (HH:MM)

old_id.Description: Original Participant ID during EEGManyLabs data collection; usually the Team ID + running index

ehi_handedness.Description: Participant handedness as determined by Edinburgh Handedness Inventory (EHI; original 10 item version). See Oldfield (1971). The assessment and analysis of handedness: The Edinburgh inventory. Neuropsychologia 9(1):97-113

ehi_lq.Description: Laterality quotient as determined by Edinburgh Handedness Inventory (EHI; original 10 item version). See Oldfield (1971). The assessment and analysis of handedness: The Edinburgh inventory. Neuropsychologia 9(1):97-113

bfi_ext.LongName: Big Five Inventory (BFI) - Extraversion Domain Subscore
bfi_ext.Description: can take values in range [3,21]. Collected using 15 item BFI-S Form, see Soto and John (2017). Short and extra-short forms of the Big Five Inventory-2: The BFI-2-S and BFI-2-XS. Journal of Research in Personality, 68:69-81

bfi_agr.LongName: Big Five Inventory (BFI) - Agreeableness Domain Subscore
bfi_agr.Description: can take values in range [3,21]. Collected using 15 item BFI-S Form, see Soto and John (2017). Short and extra-short forms of the Big Five Inventory-2: The BFI-2-S and BFI-2-XS. Journal of Research in Personality, 68:69-81

bfi_con.LongName: Big Five Inventory (BFI) - Conscientiousness Domain Subscore
bfi_con.Description: can take values in range [3,21]. Collected using 15 item BFI-S Form, see Soto and John (2017). Short and extra-short forms of the Big Five Inventory-2: The BFI-2-S and BFI-2-XS. Journal of Research in Personality, 68:69-81

bfi_neg.LongName: Big Five Inventory (BFI) - Negative Emotionality Domain Subscore
bfi_neg.Description: can take values in range [3,21]. Collected using 15 item BFI-S Form, see Soto and John (2017). Short and extra-short forms of the Big Five Inventory-2: The BFI-2-S and BFI-2-XS. Journal of Research in Personality, 68:69-81

bfi_ope.LongName: Big Five Inventory (BFI) - Open-Mindedness Domain Subscore
bfi_ope.Description: can take values in range [3,21]. Collected using 15 item BFI-S Form, see Soto and John (2017). Short and extra-short forms of the Big Five Inventory-2: The BFI-2-S and BFI-2-XS. Journal of Research in Personality, 68:69-81

bis.LongName: BIS/BAS scales - behavioral inhibition system (BIS) subscale
bis.Description: can take values in range [7-28]. Collected using 24-item BIS/BAS version, see Carver and White (1994). Behavioral inhibition, behavioral activation, and affective responses to impending reward and punishment: The BIS/BAS scales. Journal of Personality and Social Psychology, 67, 319-333.

bas_drive.LongName: BIS/BAS scales - behavioral approach system (BAS) Drive subscale
bas_drive.Description: can take values in range [4-16]. Collected using 24-item BIS/BAS version, see Carver and White (1994). Behavioral inhibition, behavioral activation, and affective responses to impending reward and punishment: The BIS/BAS scales. Journal of Personality and Social Psychology, 67, 319-333.

bas_funseek.LongName: BIS/BAS scales - behavioral approach system (BAS) Fun Seeking subscale
bas_funseek.Description: can take values in range [4-16]. Collected using 24-item BIS/BAS version, see Carver and White (1994). Behavioral inhibition, behavioral activation, and affective responses to impending reward and punishment: The BIS/BAS scales. Journal of Personality and Social Psychology, 67, 319-333.

bas_rewardresponse.LongName: BIS/BAS scales - behavioral approach system (BAS) Reward Responsiveness subscale
bas_rewardresponse.Description: can take values in range [5-20]. Collected using 24-item BIS/BAS version, see Carver and White (1994). Behavioral inhibition, behavioral activation, and affective responses to impending reward and punishment: The BIS/BAS scales. Journal of Personality and Social Psychology, 67, 319-333.

ces_d.LongName: Center for Epidemiologic Studies Depression Scale (CES-D)
ces_d.Description: can take values in range [0,60]. Collected using CES-D Form, see Lewinsohn et al (1997). Center for Epidemiological Studies-Depression Scale (CES-D) as a screening instrument for depression among community-residing older adults. Psychology and Aging, 12, 277-287.

stai_state.Description: can take values in range [20,80]. Collected using STAI-Y Form, see Spielberger et al (1983). Manual for the State-Trait Anxiety Inventory. Palo Alto, CA: Consulting Psychologists Press.

stai_trait.Description: can take values in range [20,80]. Collected using STAI-Y Form, see Spielberger et al (1983). Manual for the State-Trait Anxiety Inventory. Palo Alto, CA: Consulting Psychologists Press.

panas_s_NA.LongName: Positive Negative Affect Schedule (PANAS) - State mood - Negative Affect Subscore
panas_s_NA.Description: can take values in range [6-30]. Collected using 20 item PANAS, see Watson et al (1988). Development and validation of brief measures of positive and negative affect: the PANAS scales. Journal of personality and social psychology, 54(6), 1063.

panas_s_PA.LongName: Positive Negative Affect Schedule (PANAS) - State mood - Positive Affect Subscore
panas_s_PA.Description: can take values in range [6-30]. Collected using 20 item PANAS, see Watson et al (1988). Development and validation of brief measures of positive and negative affect: the PANAS scales. Journal of personality and social psychology, 54(6), 1063.

kss.Description: can take values in range [1-9]. see Akerstedt & Gillberg (1990). Subjective and objective sleepiness in the active individual. International Journal of Neuroscience, 52, 29–37.

Levels.7: sleepy, but no effort to keep awake
Levels.8: sleepy, some effort to keep awake
Levels.9: very sleepy, great effort to keep awake, fighting sleep
